a1.say: Let's solve Rate-Limit an LLM Endpoint, using the Sliding Window Log approach.

a1.cap: Protect a model endpoint: RateLimiter(limit, window) allows at most limit requests in any rolling window seconds. allow(t) is called with non-decreasing timestamps t (seconds) and returns true if the request at time t is accepted. A request at time p counts against t while t − p < window.

a1.cap: Keep a queue of accepted request times. Before each decision, pop times that are at least window seconds old; they slid out of the window.
If fewer than limit remain, accept and record the request. Each timestamp is pushed and popped once, so the cost is constant on average.
Let's walk through it with the calls RateLimiter(2, 10), allow(1), allow(2), allow(3), allow(11), allow(12).
